verifiedTasks.modelRole: review-fix-worker calibration task; deterministic injected Driver is used for acceptance
verifiedTasks.substrate: fresh temporary Git repository seeded by the task factory
verifiedTasks.oracle: host-side exported judge checks immutable source/baseline/oracle IDs, baseline contents, Unicode semantics, display preservation, visible tests, and one-source-file scope; it hashes candidate patch bytes without requiring a reference solution; oracle is not in the task worktree
verifiedTasks.adequacyEvidence: public regression test and independent host semantic checks are red on the known-buggy baseline and green on both reference and distinct alternative correct implementations; no-op claim, malformed output after edits, and throw after edits are independently judged; candidate commit identity and clean Git state are separate from workspace conformance
verifiedTasks.pristineBaselineIntegrity: fresh initial Git commit; grader compares candidate against its recorded base SHA and checks only src/settings.mjs changed; task factory's ModelSpec is caller supplied
verifiedTasks.runSuiteAdapter: runner/workflow-corpus/review-loop-suite.ts exports a typed FixerSuiteCase adapter and bundle materializer; injected Driver pins the materialized baseline before delegation, preserves a worker-created candidate commit under a side ref, and the independent host probe passes
verifiedTasks.boundedOracle: candidate module import and behavior child has a 5000ms wall limit; visible check is separately limited to 10000ms; process/host confinement is not claimed
verifiedTasks.candidateIdentity: full commit SHA, recorded baseline ancestry, clean Git state, and SHA256 of actual binary patch are separately reported from semantic conformance

operationIntegrationOnly.modelAction: injected Driver edits and commits the conflict worktree source
operationIntegrationOnly.oracle: operation verifies local HEAD movement; host test checks exact changed path and resulting label cap

operationIntegrationOnly.substrate: fresh temporary Git monorepo with changed test file and untouched CLI package
operationIntegrationOnly.action: exported planner consumes actual git diff evidence and selects the deepest package owner
operationIntegrationOnly.oracle: host assertions verify the selected unit, file set, and untouched sibling

operationIntegrationOnly.substrate: fresh temporary package tree with product source and test files
operationIntegrationOnly.action: exported test-fix plan builder emits a test-fix unit from test and product files
operationIntegrationOnly.oracle: host assertion reproduces the current broad package-prefix allowlist, which also admits product source; this is a toolkit limitation, not a passing test-only scope oracle

operationIntegrationOnly.substrate: host-authored failure set with repeated signature
operationIntegrationOnly.modelAction: injected Driver returns a concrete remediation proposal
operationIntegrationOnly.oracle: host assertion checks exact proposal and explicit no-tools/read-only policy

operationIntegrationOnly.substrate: fresh temporary workspace with an on-disk captured baseline
operationIntegrationOnly.action: exported capture/check ops compare live metric evidence; monotonic guard examines baseline diff
operationIntegrationOnly.oracle: host assertions require tighter metric pass and loosened metric fail

heldoutReserve.note: reservation metadata only; no held-out task or oracle is delivered or claimed isolated

evidence.redGreen: test/campaign-workflows.test.ts: original review-task seed fails executable checks; reference and distinct alternative committed repairs pass; the other five are integration scenarios only
evidence.independentOracle: exported host judge; expected behavior and scope assertions are absent from the task worktree; candidate patch hash identifies captured bytes but is not compared with a reference solution
evidence.outputFormatIndependence: valid no-op claim grades incorrect; malformed/throwing Drivers with correct committed edits grade correct
evidence.scenarioCountMeaning: 14 named Vitest workflow cases including review output-fault cases, bounded arbitrary-module execution, and runSuite adaptation; this count is not 14 independent repair tasks
evidence.independentSubstrates: five fresh local filesystem substrates across review, merge, fleet, test-fix and ratchet integration; only the review substrate has an independent task correctness oracle
evidence.scopeLimit: one independently judged review-loop task; test-fix integration exposes a current broad-scope allowlist gap; remaining families have operation-level integration evidence only and need independently judged task corpora before role adequacy or campaign claims
